# MD4C 0.5.2

Upstream: https://github.com/mity/md4c/tree/release-0.5.2

Files copied unchanged from the `src/` directory of tag `release-0.5.2`: md4c.c, md4c.h, md4c-html.c, md4c-html.h, entity.c, entity.h. MIT license is in LICENSE.md and at the top of each source file. The build copies the notice into the launcher bundle / licenses directory.

M2CL uses the standard GFM-compatible Markdown-to-HTML output, followed by a native rich-text HTML sanitizer and the existing bounded asynchronous image loader. No browser engine or remote Markdown conversion service is used.
